correctness.rationale: Under n>=3 over C and Nasu’s basepoint-free complete |D| contraction, adjunction gives K_S=(n-3)h, h²=2^n, E²=1-n, D.E=0. One general pencil member containing E decomposes E+R with R.E=n-1 transverse intersections, each an ordinary A1 critical point; local expansion a+zg(t)+O(z²) makes the first-jet incidence branches generically reduced. Away from E, the degree-(n-1) ambient subsystem separates 2-jets and general singular members are nodal; the conormal of Y is generically degree one in characteristic zero. Euler characteristic/jet Chern yields N_D=e(S)+3D²+2K.D=(11n²-31n+24)2^(n-1)+5n-9; subtracting n-1 gives the dual degree. Independent exact coefficient calculations agree for n=3..7, e.g. 124,616,2316. Finite identities do not establish general local geometry.
